lines: Phases 1 to 5 complete. Phase 6 in progress. Three words are asked of Brandon. One: move on to the film and the masters, or one more round of looks first, asked in Status 236 at about 5:20 PM MT Friday and still unanswered. Two: take the level line's mend, yes or no, asked in Status 262. Three, new: take the third what-if, fall's lit faces going out before winter's base comes, yes or no. The work goes on in any case and only the freeze waits.

The third what-if at 4K (decisions 308 and 309). Seven frames with it and five without are read, each drawn as the masters draw it (stated by the helpers as measured). Seen here at their own size: the right face goes out at film frame 2782, the left at 2794, the middle by 2806, each like a candle going out, with no hard edge left where a light was. At film frame 2836, where the main branch shows winter's pale base carrying fall's three burning faces, the what-if shows none burning. It reads clearly better at the place it was made for. Its weak point, said plainly: once out, the pumpkins read as dim rounds without a face, the right one nearly flat. The eighth frame with it, 2833, lies between two that hold and is due at about 5:20 AM MT; I say at once if it differs. One what-if on a branch, pushed by its builder, not merged without his word.

What the helpers named beside the faces at 4K is the main branch's too, so it is not the what-if's and goes on fall's list for a round three (item 291, widened): while the globe travels, the highlights on fall's dark roots are drawn as ladders of level bars, the copper roots as rows of dashes and the web as a grey wedge with a crisp border; and for a few frames fall's wicker and clasps still lie on winter's base, which is how the two bases are handed over. No edit is ordered on the main branch.

The controls' rework for an early shake, item 285: the hosted measure of the live page before the rework is read whole (decision 308). On a hosted Mac with a graphics card the first picture comes 2.8 to 8.7 s after a warm load, 16.9 and 20.4 s after a cold one; the page says ready 19 to 44 s after the first picture; a shake pressed 5 s after the first picture lands 8.9 to 16.5 s after the press, and 2.4 to 3.4 s after it once the page is ready. Those waits are what the rework is for. Its first half is pushed and read whole; its second half and whole report are due by 5:50 AM MT, then the same hosted measure with it. No ruling before those are read.

Two things from that measure. The shader warning the page writes into the console on Windows (a value the compiler thinks may be read before it is set) is open item 282 from decision 259: three rewrites were tried then and each drew fall's leaves flat on the cloud's machines, so the text stays as it is; the picture is right on both. I opened it a second time as item 293 in decision 308 by mistake and closed that as a duplicate (decision 310); no rewrite is ordered and the warning stays, to be named at delivery. Item 294 is new: the live page has no answer when the browser takes its drawing context away. That happened once in 18 hosted loads, left 62 console messages, and the load after it showed the notice that the browser cannot draw the globe. A fresh builder is on it since 5:11 AM MT: the page is to keep a whole picture, come back by itself and stay silent in the console, proven by a test that forces the loss; first word due by 5:50 AM MT, whole report by 6:50 AM MT.

The counter of broken pixels that works on Windows: its second report is read whole here (one run 2.52 percent slower than the main branch, one 0.21 percent quicker, the page's start met, the machine unsteady). The third measure, with its bars set beforehand, is due by 5:35 AM MT; it merges as chain 47 only if it passes. The render instructions for his computer are not on the main branch yet: its builder's last report came in at 5:18 AM MT; next it is read whole, the whole test suite is run on the merged tree, a fresh reader checks it cold, it is merged, and Partner is told.
The first two what-ifs' reworks: the sand mound's is due by 5:50 AM MT and the leaves' by 6:20 AM MT; each is drawn at 4K before it is offered.

Remaining in phase 6 and what he receives. The render instructions: one file in the repo and one line to give Claude Code. The what-ifs, each shown before and after at 4K, none merged without his word. On his word the freeze: the repo goes private and the references are redrawn. Then the film steps of the build order and the full 4K 60 render on his gaming PC on his word: With Prompt and Without Prompt at 3840x2160, the Portfolio Looping Video and the Portfolio Screenshot. Last the fresh review and BUILD COMPLETE. Sound credits 7,420 of 10,000 (measured from the ledger at 5:13 AM MT: 52 calls), no call since 10:47 PM MT Wednesday. No film render and no new preview video. The live page is the sixteenth publish, unchanged since 2:57 AM MT.
